gloss: to resell; to scalp; to flip

definitions.gloss: to resell; to scalp; to flip
definitions.explanation: To buy something and sell it again, typically at a higher price for profit. In modern Japanese, carries a strongly negative connotation due to association with ticket scalping and hoarding of limited goods.

examples.japanese: ⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{転売|てんばい}する。
⟦{限定品|げんていひん}→限定品：16189_genteihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高値|たかね}→高値：14703_takane⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{転売|てんばい}する⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: There are people who resell limited items at high prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ご⟦{遠慮|えんりょ}→遠慮：01337_enryo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please refrain from purchasing for resale purposes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦コンサート→コンサート：01360_konsaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チケット→チケット：11014_chiketto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定価|ていか}→定価：04066_teika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{何倍|なんばい}→何倍：22969_nanbai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{転売|てんばい}されて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Popular concert tickets are being resold at many times the original price.

notes:
Has become a hot social topic in Japan. ⟦{転売|てんばい}{屋|や}→転売屋：24325_tenbaiya⟧ (resellers/scalpers) are widely criticized for buying up concert tickets, limited-edition goods, and even daily necessities during shortages. Japan passed a law in 2019 specifically banning ticket resale ({チケット不正転売禁止法|ちけっとふせいてんばいきんしほう}).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{転売|てんばい}{屋|や}→転売屋：24325_tenbaiya⟧: scalper, reseller
- ⟦{転売|てんばい}{禁止|きんし}→転売禁止：24791_tenbaikinshi⟧: resale prohibited
- ⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: for resale purposes
- ⟦{高額|こうがく}→高額：14704_kougaku⟧⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧: selling at inflated prices
- ⟦{不正|ふせい}→不正：01660_fusei⟧⟦{転売|てんばい}→転売：10558_tenbai⟧: illegal resale

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell — neutral, general selling
- {横流|よこなが}し⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to divert goods — selling through unofficial channels
- ⟦{中古|ちゅうこ}→中古：03479_chuuko⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{売|う}る→売る：00906_uru⟧: to sell second-hand — selling used items, neutral connotation
